en.trackName: Crux: No Ads Games Daily Hub
en.description:
No ads. Crux is a daily games hub where you play, chat and make friends: word games, logic grids, number games, trivia and quick arcade rounds in one app, with a new set every day. Play at your own pace, keep your streak going, and see how your friends did. No account needed to start.

NO ADS
Crux shows no ads. No banners, no video ads, no pop-ups. You open the app and play.

A NEW SET EVERY DAY
Each day brings a new set of games. Play one or play them all, in any order. Come back tomorrow and a new set is waiting.

A HUB OF GAMES
- Word: a quick crossword, word hunts on square and hex grids, letter swaps, and four-group sorting.
- Logic: place crowns so none touch, split a grid into parcels, link pipes into one network, and draw one line through every cell.
- Numbers: crack the hidden equation, race quick mental math, and clear a grid of number pairs.
- World and trivia: name flags and capitals, spot famous landmarks, and climb a trivia ladder.
- Color: sort hues into a smooth gradient and mix a target shade.
- Arcade: clear level after level in Flash Balls, stack and merge letters in Letter Tumble, and out-type the rising lava in Word Tower.


STREAKS AND REWARDS
Your streak grows each day you play. Beat your own times, earn coins as you solve, and pick up reward chests along the way. Chests are earned by playing and are not sold, and their odds are shown in the app before you open one.

MAKE FRIENDS AND CHAT
Add friends by code, send a duel on the same game, and compare results. Start a table to chat with your group and see how everyone did on today's set, or join a public table to meet new players and talk about the day's games. Messages and profile photos are checked before other players see them, and you can block or report other players. Friends, chat and leaderboards are off for players under 13.

OFFLINE GAMES & NO WIFI GAMES
Looking for games to play without internet? Many of Crux's mini games work offline, with endless modes and handcrafted challenges to keep you playing. Enjoy solo challenges and multiplayer games, switch off sounds or haptics, and export or delete your data from Settings at any time.

IN-APP PURCHASES
Optional in-app purchases include gem and coin packs, a starter pack, season pass tracks and tips. Purchases are not available to players under 13.

CRUX PLUS
Crux Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Members get a daily drop of gems and coins, double XP on every solve, Family Sharing, and the other perks listed on the Crux Plus screen in the app.
- Monthly: $4.99 per month. Yearly: $39.99 per year. These are US prices. Prices in other countries may differ and are shown in the app before you buy.
- New subscribers get a one-week free trial. When the trial ends, the plan you chose begins and your Apple Account is charged its price.
- The subscription renews automatically for the same period at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period, or the trial, ends.
- Manage or cancel at any time in your Apple Account settings, under Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://crux.quest/terms
Privacy Policy: https://crux.quest/privacy
Support: support@crux.quest or https://crux.quest/support
